title: Tideline — Ocean Wave Studio
description: A WebGL Gerstner-wave ocean you can tune, light, populate with bobbing buoys, and capture as a photo.
concept: Tideline renders a real deep-water wave field (four summed Gerstner waves with proper dispersion, ω=√(g·k)) that you sculpt with amplitude, wavelength, choppiness, speed and wind-direction sliders, or jump to a Calm/Choppy/Storm/Tsunami sea state. Tap the water to drop colorful buoys that bob and ride the actual wave height in real time, orbit the camera around the scene, and switch between Day/Sunset/Night lighting. Save named presets, auto-resume your last session, share a state via URL, and export a composited PNG of exactly what you see.
features: 4 sea-state presets plus 5 live wave-physics sliders (amplitude, wavelength, choppiness, speed, wind direction)
3 lighting modes (Day/Sunset/Night) with matched sky, fog and specular tuning
Tap-to-drop buoys that physically bob on the live Gerstner wave height, tap again to remove
Orbit camera with drag-to-rotate and scroll/pinch-to-zoom
Named preset save/load/delete, autosave of last session, shareable URL-hash state, and composited PNG export
tech: Summed Gerstner waves with deep-water dispersion
Canvas toBlob PNG export (composited with sky gradient)

interaction.mouse: Drag to orbit the camera, scroll wheel to zoom, click the water to drop or remove a buoy
interaction.click: Tap sea-state / sky preset chips to change conditions instantly
interaction.touch: One-finger drag to orbit, two-finger pinch to zoom, tap water to place a buoy, Controls tab slides up the panel
